theorem.name: SharedCircleClutchingTopologicalThreeFamilyTheorem
theorem.statement: The A102 rank-one Fu-Yau topology admits smooth non-pullback SU3 bundles whose restriction to every shared-circle slice is the V3 smooth bundle and whose third Chern number is plus or minus six, obtained by winding plus or minus three in pi5(SU3).
